title: Arbitrary Origin Reflection with Credentials on REST API
description: The WordPress REST API previously reflected untrusted Origin headers with credentials enabled.
claimed_root_cause: Nginx / WordPress CORS filter dynamically echoed incoming Origin headers with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.

trace.description: Response returns locked Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://nenenainaemak.duckdns.org and Allow-Credentials: false

evidence.description: Tested GET /wp-json/ with Origin: https://evil-attacker.com returned locked origin and Allow-Credentials: false

reason: Verified remediated. The server now returns an allowlisted Origin (https://nenenainaemak.duckdns.org) and disables credentials (false), blocking cross-origin credentialed requests.

title: WordPress REST API User Enumeration via /wp/v2/users
description: Unauthenticated callers could previously enumerate all system usernames and IDs via the REST API.
claimed_root_cause: Default WordPress REST API exposed the users collection to unauthenticated clients.

evidence.description: HTTP request to /wp-json/wp/v2/users returned 404 Not Found with code rest_no_route.

reason: Verified remediated. The users endpoint is completely disabled for unauthenticated users, preventing user enumeration.

title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
description: Web server responses previously lacked a Content-Security-Policy header.
claimed_root_cause: Nginx configuration did not define a Content-Security-Policy header.

trace.description: Incoming HTTP request for root document

evidence.description: Content-Security-Policy header verified present with directives: default-src 'self' https: data: blob: 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; script-src 'self' https: 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; frame-ancestors 'self'; object-src 'none';

reason: Verified remediated. A robust Content-Security-Policy header is now enforced across responses.

title: Public Disclosure of Installation and License Files
description: Direct access to /readme.html and /license.txt was previously permitted.
claimed_root_cause: Nginx did not restrict access to documentation and text files in the web root.

trace.description: Server blocks request and returns HTTP 404 Not Found

evidence.description: HTTP GET /readme.html and /license.txt returned 404 Not Found.

reason: Verified remediated. Files are now blocked at the Nginx level.

title: Missing Subresource Integrity on External Scripts
description: External scripts from CDN were previously loaded without integrity hashes.
claimed_root_cause: Script tags lacked the integrity and crossorigin attributes.

trace.description: Script tag includes SHA-512 SRI hash and crossorigin attribute

evidence.description: Script tag verified: <script src="...three.min.js" integrity="sha512-dLxUelApnYxpLt6K2iomGngnHO83iUvZytA3YjDUCjT0HDOHKXnVYdf3hU4JjM8uEhxf9nD1/ey98U3t2vZ0qQ==" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerpolicy="no-referrer">

reason: Verified remediated. Script tag now includes valid SHA-512 SRI checksum, preventing tampered CDN script execution.
